fiz.translation:
n. 发嘶嘶声, 有泡沫的饮料
v. 作嘶嘶声

fizgig.definition: n. a firework that fizzes as it moves
fizgig.translation:
n. 发嘶嘶声的烟火
a. 轻狂的

fizz.translation:
vi. 嘶嘶响, 显示兴奋
n. 嘶嘶声, 兴奋, 活力

fizzed.translation: v. （液体, 通常指饮料）起泡, 发嘶嘶声( fizz的过去式和过去分词 )

fizzes.definition:
n an effervescent beverage (usually alcoholic)
v become bubbly or frothy or foaming
fizzes.translation: v. （液体, 通常指饮料）起泡, 发嘶嘶声( fizz的第三人称单数 )

fizzier.translation: a. 嘶嘶的, 泡沫腾涌的( fizzy的比较级 )

fizziest.translation: a. 嘶嘶的, 泡沫腾涌的( fizzy的最高级 )

fizzing.translation: v. （液体, 通常指饮料）起泡, 发嘶嘶声( fizz的现在分词 )

fizzle.definition:
n a fricative sound (especially as an expression of disapproval)
n a complete failure
v end weakly
fizzle.translation:
n. 嘶嘶声, 失败
vi. 发嘶嘶声, 失败

fizzled.translation: v. 发嘶嘶声, 失败( fizzle的过去式和过去分词 )

fizzles.definition:
n a fricative sound (especially as an expression of disapproval)
n a complete failure
v end weakly
fizzles.translation: v. 发嘶嘶声, 失败( fizzle的第三人称单数 )

fizzling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Fizzle
fizzling.translation: v. 发嘶嘶声, 失败( fizzle的现在分词 )

fizzy.translation: a. 嘶嘶作响的, 起泡沫的
